# noderings_marketplace_regions (Data Source)

Cities where something is for sale on the marketplace, sorted by country and city.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_marketplace_regions" "vm" {
  asset_type = "virtual_machine"
}

output "cities" {
  value = [for r in data.noderings_marketplace_regions.vm.regions : "${r.city}, ${r.country}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_type` (String) Only cities selling this: `virtual_machine` or `game_server`. Omit for both.

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) Cities with offers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City name.
- `country` (String) Country name.
